route_title: Ge/ZnS Dual-Band Filter with Constricted Thickness Bounds [80-400 nm]
compilation_rationale: Compiles a 22-layer alternating Ge/ZnS dielectric stack on CaF2 for dual-band IR transmission. Quarter-wave initial thicknesses are set per specification within [80, 400] nm bounds. Four mean-transmittance targets enforce passband maximization and stopband suppression. Coherent propagation is solved via smatrix at normal incidence. Optimizer learning rate is halved to reduce step size.
